=== Day 1: the town meeting ===
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it longer. I am the Surveyor."
Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Docks shares the same alignment."  [case board: #23, #24]
Merrin: "Let the heavens bear witness before the fiend strikes me down in my bed—I am the Rumormonger!"
Merrin: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Lian and Nisha is Marked, and may read as evil."  [case board: #25, #26]
Nisha: "It isn't a locked deduction yet, still—my read on Fenwick isn't clean."  [case board: #27]
Fenwick: "Friends and neighbors, the hour calls for a grand unveiling! I am the Dowser!"
Fenwick: "This afternoon, on the Docks I sensed 2 evil among Nisha, Hollis, Merrin."
Fenwick: "Friends, my instincts seldom miss a sour note, and Hollis rings false to me!"

Odette: "Before you invent a grander theory: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Agnes pass by."
Odette: "I have a perfectly good reason to suspect Bartholomew, which I shall share when it suits me."  [case board: #95, #96]
Bartholomew: "Don't trust Constance. I saw them out in the street from my window on the first night."  [case board: #97, #98]
Constance: "I must voice my misgivings regarding Odette; their conduct troubles me."  [case board: #99]
Odette: "Miraculously, Bartholomew and I are of one mind regarding Constance."  [case board: #100]
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Odette's Night Watch reading (the night before you arrived); or Odette's Night Watch reading (night 1)."
Lian: "I back Constance's read on Odette."  [case board: #101, #64, #65, #102]
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Bartholomew about Constance. I saw them out on the Square last night, while I was out on my duty."
Nisha: "I did see Odette out on the Market on the first night. I did see Odette out on the Square last night."  [case board: #103, #67, #104, #105]
Hollis: "I concur with Constance's assessment of Odette. An additional private ground remains undisclosed for the present."  [case board: #106]
